review:
An early John Hunter game on variable pay-ways instead of fixed lines, so the number of ways changes from spin to spin and the base game has a less predictable rhythm.

An ancient book plays a part in the free spins, where every win is multiplied by up to 10x – that multiplier is what makes the bonus worth it. 96.5% RTP. Interesting if you want to see where the series started.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Provider doesn't publish a volatility rating
No confirmed official max win figure
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
